descriptionHtml:
As part of “The Career Blueprint”, the IEEE Student Branch of the University of Peradeniya, in collaboration with the IEEE PES and IEEE ComSoc Student Branch Chapters, successfully conducted Session 01: Interview Preparation Session on 28th May 2025.

This online session, held via Zoom, was conducted by Ms. Nadeesha Wickramasinghe, Group Head of Human Resources at VSIS Groups of Companies, who brought her extensive expertise in talent acquisition and career development. The session provided participants with practical insights into effective interview techniques, covering:

  • Interview strategies to handle different formats and questions with confidence.

  • Professional etiquette and the importance of personal branding in interviews.

  • Resume presentation tips, focusing on tailoring applications to meet industry expectations.

The interactive session encouraged students to actively engage with the resource person through Q&A segments, allowing them to address specific doubts and concerns related to job interviews.

By combining industry-relevant knowledge with practical advice, this session equipped final-year undergraduates with the confidence and skills needed to excel in competitive recruitment processes. It also reflected IEEE’s mission of empowering students through knowledge-sharing and professional development opportunities.
